title: Every Place on the Fortnite Map After 43.10
caption:
#EpicPartner What changed in 43.10 and a full tour of every place on the Fortnite map. Use code BAD in the Item Shop.
#Fortnite #FortniteMap

claims.text: 16 places on the map: 11 named locations, 5 landmarks
claims.visual: 11 ids with .POI., 5 UnNamedPOI ids

claims.text: Game build is v43.10
Nami's Tangerine Grove is on the map (landmark), in the south-west of the island, closest named Windmill Village ~200 m
claims.visual: map pixel (710.1, 1560.9); not in the pre-43.10 map

claims.text: Buggy's Beachhead is on the map (named location), in the north of the island, closest named Lantern Landing ~360 m
claims.visual: map pixel (1031.1, 850.9); not in the pre-43.10 map

claims.text: 3 places no longer on the map: Boogie Boat, Fortune's Fort, Loot Lagoon
